title: Senior Tax Analyst, Corporate Tax
description:
Where Conviviality is at work.

Pernod Ricard is a global premium international champagnes and spirits company. We’re the team behind leading brands such as ABSOLUT® Vodka, Jameson® Irish Whiskey, Malibu®, Kahlúa® Liqueur, The Glenlivet®, Beefeater and Malfy Gins, and a leading portfolio of American whiskey brands including Jefferson’s, Rabbit Hole, TX, Smooth Ambler and Skrewball™ whiskey.

Working at Pernod Ricard is all about igniting conviviality in all that we do. Derived from the French word, convivialité…it means human connection, authenticity, friendly, and jovial. Conviviality is energy and spirit with a splash of je ne sais quoi and is a core philosophy around how we live and work at Pernod Ricard.

  

Guided by our 4 core values: (1) grounded in the real; (2) fiercely authentic; (3) passion for challenge; and (4) connected beyond borders; we are team players, dream makers, trailblazers, movers and (cocktail) shakers. We have a passion for living life to the fullest, making new friends every day, and realizing our potential as people and as a business!

The salary range for this role, based in New York, is $91,300.00 to $125,598.00. The range may vary if the role outside of this location. Base salaries are determined during our interview process, by assessing a candidate’s experience, skills against internal peers and against the scope and responsibilities of the position.

**Job Summary:**

Join Pernod Ricard's U.S. Tax team and play a critical role in supporting tax compliance, reporting, and planning activities across a dynamic portfolio of domestic and international entities. Reporting to the Tax Director, this role offers broad exposure to corporate income tax, tax accounting, audits, transfer pricing, and strategic tax initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity for a tax professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, partnering across functions, and contributing to a high-performing finance organization.

**Who will love this job:**

You will thrive in this role if you:

* Enjoy navigating complex tax regulations and translating technical concepts into business insights.
* Have a strong attention to detail and take pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work.
* Are naturally curious and stay informed on evolving tax laws and regulatory developments.
* Enjoy partnering with stakeholders across finance, accounting, FP&A, and international teams.
* Take ownership of your work and can successfully manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Are motivated by continuous learning, process improvement, and finding more efficient ways to work.

**What you’ll do**:

  

* Prepare federal income tax and non-income tax filings.
* Review state and local income tax returns to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Support quarterly and year-end tax provision processes, including forecast reporting and IFRIC 23 requirements.
* Prepare monthly tax account reconciliations and analyze tax-related balances.
* Respond to notices and inquiries from federal, state, and local taxing authorities.
* Assist with federal and state tax audits and support requests from auditors.
* Manage and monitor tax filing calendars to ensure timely compliance with all filing obligations.
* Conduct tax research and contribute to tax planning initiatives and transfer pricing analyses.
* Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, affiliates, and global tax teams on tax-related matters.
* Monitor technical tax developments and assess potential impacts on the business.
* Participate in special projects and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance tax processes and controls.

**What’s in it for me?**

Being part of an inclusive and diverse company where professional development and internal career mobility is front-and-center to our talent strategy. This means your career at Pernod Ricard has many possibilities. You'll be part of a culture that celebrates the rich diversity of our people across the globe and be part of our long-standing commitment to making exceptional products, giving back to our communities, and honoring our responsibility to preserve the environment.

**Required qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field.
* CPA designation required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience within a Big 4 or well-regarded public accounting firm focused on corporate tax compliance and reporting.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. corporate income tax law, state and local taxation, and international tax concepts.
* Experience preparing and reviewing corporate income tax returns and related tax accounting under ASC 740 and/or IAS 12.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, ONESOURCE, and Bloomberg Tax.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex information and deliver actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a passion for learning and process enhancement.

**Job Posting End Date:**

**Target Hire Date****:**

2026-12-14

When you join Pernod Ricard, you’ll experience a workplace that is rich in heritage, driven by our iconic brands and a long-standing commitment to sustainability, safety, and giving back to the people and communities where we work. We know that happiness at work starts with that feeling of belonging you get from an inclusive culture where being uniquely you is celebrated. Our values are lived, they drive our behaviors, and it’s what brings our culture to life.

  

Our work philosophy celebrates the magic of human connection with the flexibility needed to provide one's most meaningful contribution. We offer a flexible work policy, with most of our positions offering a a hybrid option with flexibility to work remotely 2 days a week. As a global employer, we understand that not everyone’s working hours are the same, and we empower our employees to work the hours that make the most sense for them and their team’s schedules.

  

We offer employees great benefits and perks to toast to a life filled with support. Check out PRUSABenefits.com for details.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
Is the opportunity to join a culture where “We Do the Right Thing,” and “We Courageously Shape Our Future Together” important to you? If so, Guardian is seeking a motivated individual to join our team as a Financial Analyst.

Reporting to the Head of Planning & Expense Consolidation, this role plays a central position within Group FP&A, supporting consolidated expense planning, reporting, and strategic analytics across the Group Benefits organization.

The Financial Analyst partners closely with Expense Management, Product, Pricing, and senior leadership to deliver actionable insights, enhance expense transparency, and support business decision-making. This role combines executive reporting, operational rigor, and forward-looking analytics to influence financial outcomes.

**You will**

Expense Planning & Leadership Support

* Own consolidated expense exhibits supporting the annual planning process and executive leadership reviews
* Develop clear, executive-ready materials highlighting key drivers, risks, and opportunities
* Partner with Expense Management to validate planning assumptions

Strategic Expense Analytics

* Support enterprise-wide expense studies and benchmarking initiatives
* Provide detailed analytics across product, department, and account dimensions
* Translate complex financial data into actionable insights
* Strategically partner and support transformational initiatives inclusive of business case development

Unit Cost & Performance Metrics

* Own monthly unit cost reporting, validation, and distribution
* Ensure timely and accurate refresh of YTD expense data
* Enhance visibility into cost efficiency and performance trends

Product Allocations

* Own and maintain product allocation methodologies across Group cost centers
* Partner with Pricing and business leaders to support product margin targets
* Resolve allocation variances across Group and Corporate structures

Transformation & Organizational Support

* Support transformation initiatives and organizational changes
* Validate department alignment and assess financial implications
* Identify opportunities to streamline and improve planning processes

Product Strategy Support

* Partner with product teams on profitability and cost analysis
* Provide expense insights tied to allocations and unit cost drivers

Ad Hoc & Cross-Functional Analysis

* Deliver targeted expense analyses for actuarial, regulatory, and leadership needs
* Support cost management, acquisition, and renewal analysis
* Respond to evolving business priorities with strong analytical support

Systems & Controls

* Participate in UAT testing and enhancements for financial systems (e.g., Oracle)
* Ensure integrity, accuracy, and efficiency of expense reporting processes
* Support automation and modernization of FP&A workflows

Technical Skills

* Excel (advanced beginner to intermediate)
* Formulas (SUMIFS, INDEX/MATCH, basic modeling)
* Data manipulation (pivot tables, lookups)
* Familiarity with financial ledger and planning tools.

Ability to:

* Analyze variances (actual vs plan, forecast vs prior)
* Identify key drivers of financial performance
* Translate data into insights

**You have**

Required

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
* 4+ years of FP&A, financial analysis, or expense management experience
* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency
* Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, executive-level insights
* Strong communication and collaboration skills

Preferred

* Experience in insurance or financial services
* Familiarity with Oracle Planning / Hyperion / SmartView
* Experience with large, matrixed organizations

**Location/Travel**

Hybrid: 3 days in a Guardian office located in Hudson Yards, NYC; Holmdel NJ; Boston, MA or Bethlehem, PA

title: FP&A Analyst - Car Rental Business
description:
**Driven to be the Best**

**People. Performance. Purpose.**

At Avis Budget Group, we’re driven to be the best vehicle rental company in the world, together. Our 25,000 employees raise the bar every day, bringing different perspectives, taking ownership, and leading with integrity. We’re defining the future of mobility with safe, sustainable solutions that move people, businesses, and communities forward.

We're looking for an **FP&A Analyst** to join the team supporting financial reporting and performance analysis across our rental business segments. This role sits at the intersection of Sales and Finance — translating commercial performance into financial results and helping the business understand why the numbers move the way they do. The core focus of this role is supporting the ongoing development of our profit allocation tool.

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Prepare recurring and ad hoc reporting on business segment performance (e.g., corporate accounts, channels, geographies, rate/mix)
* Analyze P&L results against sales plans, forecast, and prior year; identify and explain key drivers of variance
* Support the Sales–Finance link by translating account/segment performance trends into financial terms sales leaders can act on, and vice versa
* Assist in building out and maintaining the revenue and cost allocation tool — including logic for attributing P&L cost lines down to the rental agreement level, and applying driver-based allocation methods for costs that can't be directly attributed
* Partner with IT, Risk, and other Finance teams to gather requirements, test logic, and validate outputs as the allocation tool evolves
* Pull and manipulate data from internal systems (Oracle/OCI, Redshift, etc.) using SQL; build and maintain models/reporting in Excel
* Support month-end closing and reporting cycles with accurate, timely deliverables
* Step in to support the wider Commercial Finance team on ad hoc projects and priority requests
* Continuously looking for ways to improve reporting efficiency and data quality

**Perks You’ll Get:**

  

* Access to Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability insurance
* Eligible to elect other voluntary benefits including: Group Auto Insurance, Group Home Insurance, Pet Insurance, Legal Assistance, Identity Theft Protection, FSA, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and additional life insurance coverages
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with company matched contributions
* Full training to learn the business and enhance professional skills
* Employee discounts, including discounted prices on the purchase of Avis/Budget cars
* Access to an Employee Assistance Program for services including counseling, financial and legal consultation, referrals for care service and more

**What We're Looking For:**

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — comfortable digging into data to find the "why"
* Working knowledge of P&L structure and financial analysis fundamentals
* Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to work cross-functionally
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; comfort with the broader Microsoft Office suite
* SQL/Python proficiency a strong plus
* Familiarity with applying AI/automation tools to reporting and analysis workflows is a plus
* A genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for the business, not just the numbers
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or related field (or equivalent experience)

The annual starting salary for this position is between $65,000 – $80,000 annually. Factors that may affect starting pay within this range include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

**Who We Are:**

Here at Avis Budget Group, you will be joining a team of 25,000 driven people, performing with purpose. Together, we’re moving the future of transportation forward with our innovative, customer-focused solutions.

Our culture is performance driven, where we encourage and support each other to be at our best through leadership, training, tools, and rewards.

We are proud to make a positive difference to the lives of our colleagues, customers, and communities where we operate.

*Avis Budget Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other category protected by applicable law.*

This advertisement does not constitute a promise or guarantee of employment. This advertisement describes the general nature and level of this position only. Essential functions and responsibilities may change as business needs require. The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law. This position may be with any affiliate of Avis Budget Group.

title: Director of Finance
description:
Compensation Type: Yearly Highgate Hotels:

Highgate is a leading real estate investment and hospitality management company with over $15 billion of assets under management and a global portfolio of more than 400 hotels spanning North America, Europe, the Caribbean, and Latin America.

With a 30-year track record as an innovator in the hospitality industry, this forward-thinking company provides expert guidance through all stages of the property cycle, from planning and development through recapitalization or disposition. Highgate continues to demonstrate success in developing a diverse portfolio of bespoke lifestyle hotel brands, legacy brands, and independent hotels and resorts, featuring contemporary programming and digital acumen. The company utilizes industry-leading revenue management tools that efficiently identify and predict evolving market dynamics to drive outperformance and maximize asset value.

With an executive team of seasoned hospitality leaders and corporate offices worldwide, Highgate is a trusted partner for top ownership groups and major hotel brands. www.highgate.com

Location:

Park Lane New York, situated on Billionaires’ Row – home to the world’s most coveted addresses on  
Central Park South – has been completely reimagined as a departure from its neighbors and serves as a  
unique and inclusive retreat within walking distance of the city’s cultural hubs including Lincoln Center,  
Carnegie Hall, 5th Avenue shopping, and the Museum of Modern Art. The 47-story property features 610  
rooms – nearly half of which provide sweeping park-facing views – and 11,000 square feet of reimagined  
indoor and outdoor event space. A fitness center perched on the fifth floor offers state-of-the-art  
equipment and its own separate outdoor terrace. The reimagined hotel features three new food & beverage venues throughout the hotel including an 80-seat lobby bar with an outdoor promenade, an intimate restaurant on the hotel’s second floor, and CentralPark South’s only rooftop lounge atop the hotel. Perched on the 47th floor, the cocktail bar will treat guests to a one-of-a-kind experience against the backdrop of Manhattan's sprawling skyline and park.

  
Overview:

The Director of Finance is responsible for providing consistent leadership in the financial area of the hotel by focusing on the profitability of the business; maintaining accurate and timely financial reporting; ensuring acceptable levels on internal control; ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations and Highgate Hotels ‘s Standard Operating Procedures; and safeguarding owners/investors assets.

Responsibilities:  

* Effectively manage and communicate cash flow related issues. This includes the accurate and timely preparation of monthly financial statements for the property: cash flow statements, management of receivables, payables, cash balances, control mechanisms and timely deposits of all funds.
* Monitor hotel revenues and expenses and ensure the accurate recording in accordance with Highgate Hotels established guidelines. Monitors and controls Hotel’s cash flow and operating forecast.
* Creates annual budgets and monthly variance analysis. Investigates and critiques variances to budget or to prior year and offer practical improvement methodologies to management.
* Ensure hotels’ compliance on all regulatory licenses and permits, leases, contracts, legal agreements, and the proper execution of all operational taxes. Provide assistance to management in enforcing compliance on all these items.
* Analyze financial data and operations in order to assist and advise management in maintaining the hotels’ financial objectives.
* Complies with Standard Accounting policies and procedures and internal controls for finance and accounting operations
* Timely reviews and approval of all balance sheet accounts, including monthly bank reconciliation and general ledger account reconciliations.
* Establish and continually audit all internal financial controls including purchasing, cash handling, disbursements, inventories, hotel assets, master keys, payroll, and employee records.
* Successful completion of all internal and external financial audits, including coordination of work with CPA firms and delivering information requested by auditors on a timely basis.
* Hire, train, supervise and develop staff, including coaching, counseling and discipline.
* Maintain compliance with Highgate Hotels’ standards and regulations to ensure safe and efficient operation of the hotel.
* Directs or prepares all financial reports in accordance with Highgate Hotels’ requirements, meeting various due dates and deadlines, i.e:
* + Weekly: A/R & A/P Aging, Flash Reports, Payroll Reports, Revenue Updates
  + Monthly: Financial Statements, Forecasting KeyStatistics Report, Cash Flow
  + Annual: Budgets, 5-Year Plans, 5-Year Capital Plans
* Timely interacts with Executive Committee members to assure that property operations are on track and under control at all times.
* Monitor hotels’ compliance in meeting required report deadlines and due dates and react accordingly.
* Monitor the accurate production of the hotel daily operating report.
* Executes other special projects and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications:

* At least 5 or more years of Hospitality Finance/Accounting experience.
* Prior Controller or Director of Finance experience, preferably at a premium-branded Hotel.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree required preferably in Finance or Accounting.
* Must supervise 2 or more employees
* Must be proficient in Windows, Company approved spreadsheets and word processing and in the operation of all hotel-specific systems.

**WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?**

The Investment Strategy Analyst supports the CIO Office / Investment Management Group in content creation, macroeconomic and market research, and asset allocation analysis. Macroeconomic and Market Research

* Track and analyze U.S. and global economic and market data.
* Topics include but not limited to: U.S. and non-U.S. equity markets, U.S. and Non-U.S. macroeconomic data, fixed income markets, global business cycles, market themes, currency dynamics and more.
* Assist in identifying shifts in macro regime.
* Assist in linking analyzed economic and market data to asset allocation / multi asset-class portfolio positioning for decision makers

Investment Content Creation

* Convert current macroeconomic data, research, and analysis findings into easily digestible/consumable multi-media content; including but not limited to charts, presentations, webinars, written (both short and long form) material and scripts.
* Draft market commentary in plain, precise language, and tailor the same message for the Investment Strategy Committee, portfolio manager, advisor, and client (retail and institutional) audiences, all with varying levels of market sophistication.

* Support current production of and contribute to new recurring materials: weekly, monthly, quarterly, annually, and ad hoc.

* Maintain full data provenance so every conclusion can be traced back to its source.
* Help maintain narrative consistency, by tracking prior views and language.

* Help connect macroeconomic conclusions to asset-class views and portfolio positioning in materials.
* Assist in analysis of asset allocation and multi-asset portfolio construction: asset allocation reviews, valuation and positioning comparisons, and performance and risk inputs across equities, international equities, and fixed income.

* Corporate Finance - specifically with experience across FP&A, Audit and Tax

description:
**Who We Are**

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve's solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States' top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world's top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Verve For Advertisers is a technology company that empowers brands and agencies to target audiences based on declared intent, following them from initial curiosity to ultimate decisioning, to drive measurable outcomes.

As Business Unit Controller you take full financial ownership of the Marketplace Business— from revenue and cost of sales through to EBITDA. You are the finance counterpart to business unit leadership: you explain what happened, forecast what is coming, and flag what needs to change.

You will join at a point where the finance function is moving from reporting-focused controlling towards forward-looking planning and analysis. This is a hands-on role with high visibility: you will work directly with business unit leads and Group Accounting, and you will have real influence over how performance is measured and understood across the group.

  

**What You Will Do**

* **Own the business unit P&L, end to end**
  + Take ownership of the full P&L for your assigned business units: gross revenue, cost of sales, net revenue margin, personnel costs, external costs and all SG&A lines
  + Understand and challenge the operational drivers behind each line
  + Safeguard cost center and account-level integrity, ensuring spend is recorded in the correct entity, business unit and cost line
  + Manage intercompany recharges and eliminations relevant to your business units
* **Support the month-end close**
  + Prepare and review accruals, prepayments and manual adjustments within close deadlines
  + Reconcile ledger data to consolidated actuals and resolve differences before reporting
  + Produce variance analysis (month-on-month, budget-versus-actual, year-on-year) with clear root-cause commentary traceable to source data
  + Contribute to close quality improvements — fewer late adjustments and cleaner first-pass numbers
* **Present the numbers to stakeholders**
  + Present monthly performance to business unit leads and Group leadership
  + Translate financial movements into a clear business narrative rather than a list of variances
  + Own the recurring reporting pack for your business units and stand behind the detail
* **Drive budgeting, forecasting and modelling**
  + Run the annual budget and rolling forecast cycles for your business units together with operational stakeholders, in support of the Director of FP&A
  + Build and maintain driver-based financial models at the appropriate level of detail
  + Track forecast accuracy over time and explain deviations
  + Support ad-hoc modelling: scenario analysis, business cases, and margin and profitability deep dives

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in controlling or audit, ideally in a multi-entity environment
* Experience in adtech, SaaS or another platform business
* Demonstrated P&L ownership and confident financial modelling skills in Excel
* Comfort working with large ledger data sets and reconciling data across multiple systems
* The ability to present to, and constructively challenge, senior non-finance stakeholders
* Structured, accuracy-focused working style and the ability to meet close deadlines
* Fluent business English

**Nice To Have**

* Hands-on experience with LucaNet and NetSuite
* Working knowledge of IFRS in a consolidated group
* Experience in a listed company reporting environment
* Basic SQL literacy

* Health, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health resources
* 401(k) match and generous PTO
* Pre-tax FSA and HSA plans for Healthcare, Dependent care, and Commuting

description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit is a global platform company that is on a mission to power prosperity worldwide for consumers, small businesses and the self-employed. Across our four leading brands – Turbo Tax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp – Intuit serves over 100M customers and is one of the few companies in the world to have both a thriving consumer and small business ecosystem. Intuit is known for its innovation track record, customer centricity, and its consistent recognition as a top place to work.

Our team owns fraud policies across all the consumer lending and banking product suites — Onboarding risk, Money in Channels, ACH, RTP, OCT , ATO risk. We're hiring a Staff Analyst, Fraud Policy to own end-to-end policy decisions across these money movement rails: detecting emerging attacks, sizing the exposure, designing controls in our real-time decisioning stack, and defending the tradeoff between loss and member experience to leadership.

  

This is a high-leverage seat. You'll work directly with fraud strategy, data science, engineering, dispute ops, and compliance to keep the ecosystem secure without breaking the experience for legitimate members ,utilizing cutting-edge AI technology to detect and prevent fraud while minimizing impact on good customers.

**Responsibilities**

This role will involve developing fraud risk policies for our innovative consumer lending and banking products, with a focus on fraud detection and prevention for new money movement products and features. You will create end-to-end risk policies and drive alignment with cross-functional stakeholders. Additionally, you will manage fraud risk aspects of business initiatives and respond to fraud-related events and demands. Expertise in fraud risk, financial analytics, and innovative risk strategies is required to enable Intuit's growth, expansion, profitability, and trust-enabled consumer experiences.

* Use advanced analytical techniques to mine massive scale account and transactional data to build/optimize fraud risk strategies/policies, and translate into actionable business plans
* Lead the full cycle of risk strategy/policy work, including identify opportunities and action plan, develop and test policy, launch policy to production and monitor the performance
* Build subject matter expertise in different types of risks among money movement offerings to optimize the balance between risk mitigation and growth in the Intuit ecosystem
* Team up with our data scientist, risk operations, product, data engineering, analytics teams closely to drive customer segmentations, develop innovative risk strategies, and perform portfolio analyses
* Test into and recommend 3rd party data providers to solve individual stolen identity, ATO and other types of exposure risk
* Design, implement, and monitor testing to explore new methodologies and estimate key metrics for our risk strategies
* Must have good judgement with the ability to think creatively and strategically

**Qualifications**

* Strong business acumen and exceptional analytical ability, with 5+ years of relevant experience and bachelors degree in quantitative fields such as Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Data Science; or MS/PhD with 2+ years of relevant working experience.
* **Preferred experience with Fintech, Payments, NeoBanking, Crypto, or Money Movement space.**
* Working knowledge of the fundamentals of risk policy for consumer loans and line of credit including fraud detection and identity checks
* Demonstrated experience in designing experiments and using data-driven insights to solve business problems.
* Proficient in statistical analysis tools like SQL, Excel, Python, R, and data visualization tools. Familiarity with big data technologies such as Hive, Hadoop, and related concepts preferred.

Reporting to the Director of Customer Insights, in this role you will establish and evolve customer intelligence capabilities. You’ll leverage customer transactional, loyalty, and behavioral data to uncover trends, identify opportunities, and deepen understanding of our customers. The ideal candidate is a highly curious, self-motivated analyst who thrives on exploring data, asking the right questions, and uncovering meaningful insights that go beyond the numbers. This person will own customer reporting and dashboard development, perform advanced analytical analyses using SQL and statistical techniques, and partner closely with Business Intelligence, CRM, Media, Marketing, Strategy, and Finance teams to influence decisions across the customer lifecycle.  
  
 **Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Analytics & Reporting**

* Build, own, and continuously enhance recurring customer reporting that provides visibility into key customer health metrics and business performance.
* Develop scalable dashboards that monitor customer acquisition, retention, frequency, spend, loyalty engagement, customer lifetime value, and other key customer KPIs.
* Leverage first-party customer data to identify emerging trends, opportunities, and risks across the customer lifecycle.
* Translate complex analyses into concise, actionable recommendations for business leaders.

**Data Analysis**

* Analyze large-scale customer transaction, loyalty, and behavioral datasets to uncover insights into customer acquisition, retention, purchasing behavior, and lifetime value.
* Perform exploratory analyses to identify customer behaviors, segments, migration patterns, purchasing trends, and opportunities for growth.
* Apply statistical techniques—including regression analysis, driver analysis, correlation analysis, significance testing, trend analysis, and other foundational analytical methods—to uncover meaningful insights and quantify relationships within customer data.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner closely with the Business Intelligence team to understand the customer data ecosystem, data models, and evolving data platform capabilities.

* Support Strategy and Finance with customer trend analyses, growth opportunities, performance measurement and strategic business initiatives.

**Insight Generation**

* Identify the key drivers of customer behavior and business performance using rigorous quantitative analysis.
* Explore complex datasets to uncover meaningful patterns, relationships, and opportunities that may not be immediately apparent.
* Synthesize multiple data sources into clear, actionable insights that answer both the "what" and the "why" behind customer trends.
* Help establish best practices for customer analytics and reporting as the Customer Insights function continues to grow.

**Qualifications:**

* 3–6 years of experience in Customer Insights, Consumer Insights, Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, or a related analytical role.
* Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience querying large relational databases.
* Experience analyzing customer-level transaction, loyalty, CRM, or behavioral data to generate actionable business insights.
* Working knowledge of statistical methods commonly used in customer analytics, including regression analysis, driver analysis, correlation analysis, hypothesis testing, significance testing, and trend analysis.
* Experience building, owning, and maintaining dashboards and recurring reporting using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms.

**Purpose of Position:**

The C&I Portfolio Manager/Team Lead, is responsible for senior-level oversight of the risk management and performance of the Bank’s commercial and industrial portfolio, including nonprofit, CDFI, for-profit, owner-occupied mortgage financing and other mission-aligned and commercial borrowers. This role serves as a senior credit and personnel leader, exercising independent credit judgement on complex relationships, managing and developing portfolio management staff, and ensuring portfolio practices align with the Bank’s risk appetite and regulatory expectations.

In addition to overseeing a portfolio of the most complex or high-risk relationships, this role leads the C&I portfolio management team and is responsible for identifying emerging risks, strengthening portfolio management practices, improving tools and processes, and representing the C&I PM function in internal governance, audit, and regulatory contexts.

The position requires advanced C&I credit expertise, demonstrated experience managing teams and diverse loan portfolios, strong judgement, leadership capability, and the ability to work independently and influence outcomes across multiple stakeholders.

**Essential Job Functions:**

Senior Portfolio Oversight and Risk Leadership

* Provide senior-level oversight of portfolio risk, performance trends, and emerging issues across the C&I portfolio, including nonprofit, for-profit, CDFI, and other commercial and mission-aligned borrowers.
* Independently evaluate complex credits, higher risk relationships, and non-routine structures.
* Review, challenge, and approve complex credit recommendations, risk ratings, and exception requests.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for portfolio issues, including criticized assets and problem credits.
* Lead strategy development for risk mitigation, remediation plans, and workout approaches where necessary.
* Ensure portfolio management practices are consistent with Bank policy, regulatory guidance, and best practices.

Credit Expertise and Decision Influence

* Provide expert guidance on loan structures, covenant frameworks, and risk identification.
* Challenge assumptions in underwriting and portfolio management to strengthen overall credit quality.
* Contribute to policy interpretation and recommend enhancements to credit standards where appropriate.
* Represent the C&I Portfolio Management perspective in internal credit committees, governance forums, audits, and examinations.
* Perform independent research and analysis on industry developments and trends.

Leadership and Talent Development

* Lead, mentor, and provide technical guidance to AVP/VP-level portfolio managers and other team members.
* Review work product for quality, consistency, and sound credit judgement.
* Set clear performance expectations, allocate work effectively, and support staff development through timely feedback and coaching.
* Promote strong collaboration, accountability, and professional standards across the team.

Process Improvement and Strategic Contribution

* Identify opportunities to enhance portfolio management tools, reporting, and workflows.
* Partner with internal stakeholders (Credit Risk, Compliance, Technology, etc.) to improve systems and data integrity.
* Contribute to broader strategic initiatives related to C&I portfolio risk management, reporting, and growth.
* Perform other duties as assigned, including involvement in complex new originations.

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field, or equivalent advanced commercial credit experience; advanced degree or professional certification (MBA, CRC, CFA, CPA) preferred.
* 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in commercial banking and C&I portfolio management, including significant experience with nonprofit, for-profit, CDFI, owner-occupied mortgage financing, and other commercial borrowers.
* Demonstrated expertise in C&I credit structures, cash-flow and collateral analysis, covenant design, risk rating, and portfolio monitoring across diverse industries and borrower types.
* Proven ability to exercise independent credit judgement on complex, higher-risk, or non-routine transactions.
* Experience reviewing and challenging credit work prepared by others, including risk ratings, covenant structures, and exception requests.
* Experience managing criticized assets, workout situations, or remediation plans.
* Strong understanding of bank regulatory expectations, loan policy frameworks, and risk governance practices.
* Proven ability to influence outcomes across relationship managers, underwriters, credit administration, and senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience formally managing portfolio management or credit professionals, including work allocation, coaching, performance management, and talent development.
* Demonstrated ability to identify systemic risks, recommend process improvements, and contribute to portfolio-level strategy.
* Firm understanding of Federal/State Regulations including but not limited to EOCA, Regulation B, CRA and NYDFS Rule 76.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex credit concepts to senior audiences.
* High proficiency in financial analysis tools, data interpretation, and portfolio reporting.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Moody’s CreditLens, and Tableau preferred.

**About the Role:**

The Director of Ecommerce will lead the strategy, performance, and ongoing optimization of Rifle Paper Co.’s ecommerce channels, with a focus on growing online revenue, improving conversion, and strengthening the customer experience.

This role will oversee ecommerce performance from site merchandising and product content to promotional planning, channel optimization, and analytics. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and hands-on leader with a strong understanding of ecommerce operations, digital merchandising, and performance analytics. You’re equally comfortable identifying growth opportunities, interpreting performance data, managing day-to-day execution, and developing a team. Above all, you bring initiative, sound commercial judgment, and an appreciation for what makes Rifle Paper Co. distinct.

We believe great work can happen in different places, so this roles offers flexibility in where you work. You can be based in either our Winter Park, Florida or New York, New York Office, or remotely if you reside in one of the following states: Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, or Tennessee.

The anticipated salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000 annually. Final compensation offered will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and geographic location.

This role will focus on growing and optimizing Rifle Paper Co.’s DTC business, improving the online customer experience, and driving revenue and profitability through thoughtful merchandising, data-driven decisions, and cross-functional collaboration.

* Develop and execute ecommerce strategies that drive revenue growth, improve profitability, and support broader business objectives.

**The Opportunity**

Founded in 1999, Achievement First Public Charter Schools is a nonprofit network of 41 public charter schools serving approximately 15,000 students across Connecticut, New York, and Rhode Island. Our mission is to prepare every student to excel in college and career, deepen their knowledge of self and community, and lead lives of purpose. In partnership with families and communities, we work to disrupt the legacy of inequity in education and believe deeply in the unlimited potential of every student.

Achievement First is renewing academic excellence through a redesign of its K–12 instructional program. At the same time, the environment for public education is changing: families have evolving expectations and more options, and schools must deliver compelling experiences while managing cost, regulation, facilities, and technology. Internally, the network's growth outpaced the development of some central systems and shared operating practices, leaving uneven processes and insufficiently codified standards. AF has recently moved to a more decentralized model in which Regional Executive Directors lead regional academics and operations, and the COO sets networkwide standards and drives consistent performance through strong functional leadership and regional partnership.

In co-located facilities, partner with districts to meet Achievement First standards.

### **Support Student Enrollment and Essential School Services**

Own networkwide student recruitment and enrollment and set service standards for transportation, food, school safety, health and nursing, and related operational support. Direct functional teams and partners to monitor performance, fix recurring failures, and deliver dependable services. In Rhode Island, Achievement First serves as its own local education agency; in Connecticut and New York, it partners with traditional districts for essential services, requiring differentiated operating arrangements and close oversight.

Lead the Information, Technology, and Data portfolio through capable functional experts, setting enterprise priorities and holding teams accountable for reliability, security, and useful information. description:
**Job Description:** Director Trade Marketing (LDB)
  
**Job Title:** Director, Trade Marketing
  
**Division:** L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty (LDB)
  
**Reports To:** AVP, Trade Marketing
  
  
**Location:** Hudson Yards, NY
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
The Trade Marketing team at L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty (LDB) operates as the critical commercial engine and strategic bridge between our world-class brands—CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and Vichy—and our retail partners. We do not simply execute plans; we are the architects of the commercial strategy. We translate high-level national brand visions into concrete, localized, and winning trade architectures that dictate how our portfolio dominates at the shelf and on the screen.
  
  
We are looking for a powerhouse leader to step into the role of AVP, Trade Marketing. This is not a role for those who seek the path of least resistance. It is a high-visibility, high-stakes position that requires an individual with exceptional grit, an unshakeable work ethic, and a commanding professional presence. You will lead the charge in bridging marketing ambition with commercial reality, serving as a highly reliable, deeply trusted partner to both internal teams and retail giants.
  
  
The Opportunity & Your Impact
  
  
As the AVP of Trade Marketing, you will lead a high-performing team tasked with translating each brand's national strategy and defining the overarching commercial strategy for the division. You will be the ultimate owner of how CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and Vichy show up commercially, establishing the promotional guardrails, trade spending efficiency parameters, and go-to-market execution plans.
  
  
This role demands a leader who is not afraid to go toe-to-toe with General Managers, Brand Presidents, and Marketing heads. You will be the voice of commercial reality, backed by bulletproof, data-driven analytics. When tough conversations are needed regarding how national strategies must adapt to the retail landscape, or when commercial parameters must be strictly defined, you will lean in with confidence, facts, and a solution-oriented attitude.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For:** Our Future Leader
  
  
We are searching for a relentless driver who brings a masterclass balance of strategic marketing translation, commercial street-smarts, and analytic rigor. You are someone who:
  

* Is a Strategic Translator: You can look at a national brand marketing plan and immediately identify how to operationalize it into a commercial strategy that retailers buy into.
* Possesses Deep Grit: You roll up your sleeves, thrive in fast-paced complexity, and view obstacles as puzzles to be solved. You are resilient, reliable, and run toward challenges, not away from them.
* Commands the Room: You have a strong, authentic leadership style and an executive presence that immediately builds trust.
* Engages in Constructive Friction: You are comfortable speaking truth to power. You are fearless in challenging GMs, Sales leaders, and Marketers to ensure our trade strategies are both commercially sound and highly profitable.
* Is Rooted in Data: Your opinions are strong, but they are always backed by objective, meticulous analytics. You are a trusted source of truth because you let the data do the heavy lifting.

Key Job Responsibilities
  

* Define Commercial Strategy for one of our two mass brands: Serve as the chief architect in translating brand-specific national strategies into a unified, high-performing divisional commercial strategy across all key retail channels.
* Translate National Brand Ambition: Act as the strategic conduit between Brand Marketing and Sales. Take national campaigns and product launches and translate them into commercially viable retail programs for CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and Vichy.
* Commercial Guardrail Ownership: Establish and enforce rigorous divisional trade guidelines. Collaborate cross-functionally (Divisional Leadership, Sales, Marketing, and Finance) to align brand ambitions with commercial realities and strict ROI parameters.
* Fearless Stakeholder Management: Act as the strategic partner and challenger to GMs and Brand Teams. Drive the tough, necessary alignments on promotional ROI, pricing executions, and commercial trade spend when national strategies clash with field realities.
* Bulletproof Analytical Storytelling: Translate complex retailer, consumer, and financial data into clear, persuasive strategic narratives. Deliver high-impact presentations to executive leadership.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building: Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing Trade Marketing team, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous development.
* P&L and ROI Optimization: Maintain a deep, precise understanding of the divisional P&L. Rigorously analyze promotional ROI and trade spend efficiency to identify and capture profit-improvement opportunities.
* Retailer & Field Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with Field Sales and Customer Marketing to ensure our defined commercial plans are flawlessly executed, highly competitive, and customized to win across the retailer landscape.

Background & Experience Requirements
  
  
**Educational Background:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Commercial Strategy, Marketing, Commercial Finance, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related business field. MBA is a plus.

**Professional Experience & Technical Skills:**  

* 7-12+ years of experience working in a fast-paced FMCG or CPG organization, with a strong preference for deep exposure to Trade Marketing, Commercial Strategy, or Category Management.
* Experienced managerial skills with multiple direct reports and upscaling junior talent
* Strategic Translation Track Record: Proven experience taking high-level brand ideas/national strategies and successfully mapping them into commercial, retailer-facing programs.
* Proven Leadership: A track record of leading teams and directly influencing senior, multi-functional leadership.
* Commercial Acumen: A deep understanding of the US retailer landscape, trade spend mechanics, and how brand marketing strategies translate to the retail shelf.
* Financial Literacy: Strong command of product financial structures and P&L dynamics; capability to evaluate the financial health of trade investments.
* Analytical Rigor: Hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets to derive actionable insights. Familiarity with syndicated data sources (Circana/IRI, Numerator, Nielsen) and trade promotion management tools.
* Technical Proficiency: High comfort level with data visualization and analytics tools (Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau) to build data-backed arguments.

**Salary range:** $138K-$200K

title: Senior Manager, Customer Success Operations
description:
**Who we are:**

For over 25 years, Global Relay has set the standard in enterprise information archiving with industry-leading cloud archiving, surveillance, eDiscovery, and analytics solutions. We securely capture and preserve the communications data of the world's most highly regulated firms, giving them greater visibility and control over their information and ensuring compliance with stringent regulations.

Though we offer competitive compensation and benefits and all the other perks one would expect from an established company, we are not your typical technology company. Global Relay is a career-building company. A place for big ideas. New challenges. Groundbreaking innovation. It's a place where you can genuinely make an impact – and be recognized for it.

We believe great businesses thrive on diversity, inclusion, and the contributions of all employees. To that end, we recruit candidates from different backgrounds and foster a work environment that encourages employees to collaborate and learn from each other, completely free of barriers.

**Your Role**

As Senior Manager, Customer Success Operations, you will lead the operational processes, insights and frameworks that enable our global Customer Success organisation to deliver customer value, protect recurring revenue and scale effectively.

Supporting approximately 50 Customer Success professionals, you will partner closely with the Chief Customer Officer and Global Head of Sales Operations to strengthen customer engagement, renewals and account growth. You will translate business priorities into practical processes, reliable reporting and clear accountability across the post-sales customer lifecycle.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategic planning with operational delivery. You will lead a geographically distributed team and partner with Customer Success, Sales, Finance and Product to support an increasingly complex enterprise customer base.

**Your Responsibilities**

**Renewal Strategy and Revenue Protection**

* Build a proactive renewal operating model with clear milestones, ownership and escalation routes ahead of contract expiry.
* Support the transition from reactive auto-renewals to planned, strategic renewal discussions, including multi-year agreements where appropriate.
* Establish visibility into upcoming renewals, customer risk, contraction and expansion opportunities.
* Partner with Customer Success and Finance to improve renewal forecasting and explain revenue movements.
* Develop consistent reporting on MRR, ARR, gross revenue retention, net revenue retention and churn.

**Contract Reconciliation Billing and True Ups**

* Own the operational coordination of contract reconciliations and true-ups, partnering with Finance and account owners to ensure accurate, timely billing.
* Identify differences between contractual commitments, customer usage, entitlements and billing records.
* Investigate recurring discrepancies and introduce controls that reduce revenue leakage and customer friction.
* Ensure reconciliation decisions, exceptions and approvals are documented and traceable.

**Customer Engagement and Lifecycle Management**

* Develop a consistent engagement framework across onboarding, adoption, ongoing account management and renewal.
* Define account segmentation and coverage models that align CS resources with customer needs, complexity and commercial value.
* Set clear expectations for customer touchpoints, account plans, business reviews and risk escalation.
* Develop customer health scoring using product adoption, engagement, support and commercial indicators; measure effectiveness against customer outcomes.

**Data Systems and Performance Insights**

* Establish a reliable view of customer and revenue performance, with clear metric definitions and ownership.
* Build dashboards that help leaders identify risks, prioritise activity and assess team effectiveness.
* Partner with systems owners to improve CRM data quality, workflow automation and reporting consistency.
* Translate complex data into clear recommendations and simplify manual processes to improve scalability.

**Team Leadership and Cross Functional Delivery**

* Lead, coach and develop the London-based Manager and Vancouver-based Analyst.
* Set priorities and balance day-to-day operational requirements with longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Establish effective working practices across New York, London and Vancouver.
* Build partnerships across Customer Success, Sales, Finance and Product to resolve issues and deliver shared priorities.
* Lead process changes through clear communication, practical training and measurement of adoption.

**About You**

You are an experienced Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations or post-sales operations professional who combines commercial understanding with strong analytical and operational skills. You bring structure to complex environments and move comfortably between executive discussions and detailed problem-solving.

* Demonstrated experience leading Customer Success Operations or a comparable post-sales operations function within an enterprise SaaS business.
* Strong understanding of onboarding, adoption, renewals, retention and expansion.
* Financial and commercial acumen, including SaaS revenue metrics, billing, contract reconciliation and true ups.
* Experience building renewal processes, engagement frameworks, account segmentation and customer health models.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using CRM platforms, reporting tools and workflows to improve data quality and effectiveness.
* People management experience, including developing colleagues and coordinating delivery across locations and time zones.
* Confidence partnering with senior leaders, presenting recommendations and constructively challenging existing approaches.
* A hands-on approach, sound judgement and the ability to prioritise competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience supporting financial services customers, regulated industries or complex enterprise contracts would be advantageous.

**Global Relay is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must have the right to work in the USA at the time of application.**

**What you can expect:**

At Global Relay, there's no ceiling to what you can achieve. It's the land of opportunity for the energetic, the intelligent, the driven. You'll receive the mentoring, coaching, and support you need to reach your career goals. You'll be part of a culture that breeds creativity and rewards perseverance and hard work. And you'll be working alongside smart, talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with complementary knowledge and skills.

Global Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We seek to ensure reasonable adjustments, accommodations, and personal time are tailored to meet the unique needs of every individual.

**About The Job**

OpenTable is looking for an Associate Manager, Accounting to own a highly technical portfolio spanning partnership revenue, loyalty, and leases, along with other technical areas such as bad debt, prepaids, and accruals, and the close-related operations that support them. The role sits at the intersection of technical accounting, revenue recognition, contract interpretation, and cross-functional business partnership.

This is an Associate Manager–level individual contributor role with significant ownership and influence: you'll lead complex workstreams, coach teammates, streamline processes, and work cross-functionally to support business partners. It's built for someone with strong judgment and technical depth who can navigate the organization independently, lead day-to-day execution, communicate plan and progress clearly, and improve how the work gets done. This role reports to the Manager, Accounting. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end accounting for fast-growing strategic partnership revenue programs, managing complex models to support revenue and expense recognition and balance sheet treatment
* Own the technical accounting for the evolving loyalty program, using judgment to evaluate the key assumptions that drive it
* Lead the accounting across other technical areas including leases, bad debt, prepaids, and accruals, spanning multiple OpenTable legal entities, all reported under US GAAP
* Manage close-related accounting activities, including journal entries, reconciliations, and balance sheet integrity across these areas

title: Director of Strategic Sourcing and Procurement
description:
**About Suno**
==============

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

**About the Role**
------------------

Suno is hiring its very first Director of Strategic Sourcing and Procurement. Suno is one of the fastest-growing AI-native companies in the world, and as our first sourcing hire your job is simple: get us better deals and ensure we’re partnering with the right vendors.

This is a multi-faceted, hands-on role: you’ll serve as a strategic partner to all of Suno’s teams in thinking through what technology strategy best meets our needs; be our primary negotiator across our non-headcount spend (cloud, inference, software, etc.); and build the systems that allow us to confidently manage vendor relationships and risks. You’ll decide when to move fast versus when to create healthy friction, partnering closely with Legal, Finance, and Security/IT to get deals done at the best price, terms, and flexibility.

**Listen to the song we made about it:** https://suno.com/s/F9r6u4N4hN2a99w3

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Work closely with each of Suno’s business teams to define sourcing strategy: who are our key vendors, where do we have gaps where additional tooling could help, and where do we have unintended duplication or unused tools?
* Partner with every team at Suno to forecast demand, understand technical requirements, evaluate suppliers, and translate our growth into sourcing leverage. Personally negotiate with major vendors and provide tools/techniques for anyone in the company to successfully manage spend.
* Create intake and vendor contract systems that triage requests for new vendors, manage commitments, and surface renewals based on spend level, risk exposure, and usage. No surprise renewals of unused vendors, please!
* Work closely with Security/IT and Legal to ensure that security review and legal term review are achieved for relevant vendors.

**What You’ll Need**
--------------------

* Must-haves

  + 8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, and/or finops, ideally in high-growth technology companies
  + Experience negotiating directly with cloud providers and security/monitoring software with a history of demonstrated cost wins. Experience working with inference providers is highly desirable
  + Ability to partner with a wide variety of internal stakeholders. Can you ask the right question to diagnose over-provisioning of a costly service with the engineering team and also know which legal terms to focus on in an order form and MSA?
  + History of successfully deploying sourcing systems for better collaboration with internal teams and clarity on spend and usage
  + Collaboration, curiosity, and creativity. This not a role for someone who wants to slot into a defined process but rather someone who wants to reimagine what thoughtful sourcing and spend culture can unlock for a company
  + Comfort with ambiguity and high pace. You have a bias towards action over perfection and use AI to empower yourself and others
* Nice-to-haves

  + Experience setting and managing budgets for office management and real estate buildouts
  + Work at both scrappy startups and scaled organizations. Help us make stage-appropriate decisions and tradeoffs as we grow
  + Experience building and maintaining AI-powered sourcing tools and playbooks for redlining, negotiation prep, benchmarking, and vendor reporting
  + Experience with readiness for IPO

**Additional Notes:**

* Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.
* This role requires working onsite at one of our offices.

**Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees**
--------------------------------------------

* Company Equity Package
* 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)
* Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)
* 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time
* 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave
* Creative Education Stipend
* Generous Commuter Allowance
* In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

**Compensation:**
-----------------

* The annual salary range for this role is $200,000 - $275,000 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Compensation Range: $200K - $275K

Pagaya was founded in 2016 by seasoned research, finance, and technology entrepreneurs with our head quarters located in NYC and Tel Aviv.

* **Debate and Commit**- We respectfully and openly debate to strengthen our ideas and build shared conviction - once we decide, we go all in, together.

title: Program Manager, Faculty Planning
description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

**Program Manager, Faculty Planning**
=====================================

**About the Role**

The Program Manager owns the annual faculty planning cycle and ongoing staffing analysis across K–12. The role requires strong analytical judgment and disciplined program management: reconciling complex data, turning findings into clear recommendations, and ensuring that decisions, system changes, and school-level follow-up are completed.

As Success Academy opens new schools and expands beyond New York, the Program Manager will ensure every school is staffed to deliver our school design. This means anticipating staffing and leadership needs several years ahead so that hiring and development decisions are made early, grounded in accurate data, and carried through to execution.

The Program Manager serves as the business owner for our faculty planning tool, ensuring it gives school leaders and Network teams a reliable, shared view of staffing needs. The role also provides analysis that supports promotion cycles, performance tracking, incentive planning, and long-term talent development.

Working across school and Network teams, including Finance, Data & Analytics, Talent Acquisition, and People Operations and Technology, the Program Manager will coordinate decisions, clarify ownership and handoffs, and ensure work spanning teams has clear follow-through. The Program Manager will provide senior leadership with accurate data, analysis, options, and recommendations when staffing decisions require their approval.

The Program Manager will help reimagine how faculty planning operates, questioning established approaches, designing solutions around the needs of schools, and using automation and AI to focus team capacity on analysis, sound judgment, and solving complex problems.

This role is well suited to someone who has thrived as a program manager, internal or management consultant, or strategy, operations, or analytics professional. We seek a problem solver who brings analytical rigor and curiosity, navigates ambiguity, and takes ownership from design through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Faculty Planning and Staffing Strategy**

* Own the annual faculty planning calendar and year-round planning process, establishing milestones, dependencies, stakeholder responsibilities, and escalation points so staffing decisions are made in time to guide execution.
* Partner with Schooling and Finance to refine our staffing model and obtain leadership alignment on proposed changes, ensuring approved staffing standards are accurately reflected in planning tools.
* Model staffing and leadership needs over a 3–5 year horizon, assessing how changes in enrollment, course offerings, scheduling, and school design affect staffing needs.
* Monitor teacher utilization and classroom coverage, including co-teaching classrooms, coordinate follow-up with school leaders, and track issues to resolution.
* Identify capability gaps and talent shortages, and partner with Schooling and Talent Acquisition on strategies to attract, develop, and retain educators, support succession planning, and strengthen long-term talent pipelines.

**Planning Tool Management**

* Serve as the business owner for our faculty planning tool in partnership with technology and implementation partners, translating planning needs into requirements, prioritizing enhancements, and escalating scope decisions for leadership alignment.
* Test enhancements against realistic school scenarios and translate user feedback into improvements.
* Develop training and guidance so school leaders understand staffing expectations and use the tool effectively, building lasting adoption.
* Provide ongoing planning support to school leaders, and partner with technical teams to resolve tool issues.

**Cross-Functional Partnerships**

* Represent faculty planning in school and Network planning, champion Success Academy's staffing standards, and ensure decisions reflect school experience and implementation needs.
* Partner with school leaders and Network teams to obtain timely enrollment and course projections and review staffing implications before schedules are finalized, including content-area needs in high school.
* Coordinate handoffs with People Operations and Technology so staffing changes are reflected accurately and on time in all relevant systems.
* Resolve competing priorities across Schooling, Finance, and talent teams, and hold partners accountable for agreed deliverables.

**Design Thinking AI and Automation**

* Apply design thinking to identify and redesign repetitive or error-prone faculty planning processes, using automation and AI to reduce manual work, strengthen data quality, and improve scalability.
* Translate operational needs into requirements for AI-enabled workflows and agents, including expected outcomes, data inputs, human checkpoints, and quality controls, partnering with internal technology and data teams through testing and adoption.
* Maintain standard work and lead retrospectives to improve each planning cycle, embedding redesigned workflows in playbooks and documentation so critical work is not dependent on any one individual.

**Data Performance and Executive Reporting**

* Establish KPIs and dashboards to inform staffing forecasts, utilization, and broader talent decisions.
* Own the accuracy and completeness of faculty planning data, reconciling sources across planning, HR, and finance systems, and partnering with Data & Analytics on data standards.
* Produce clear executive reports and presentations that communicate findings, staffing risks, decisions required, and recommended actions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 4–6 years of experience in roles such as program management, management or internal consulting, strategy and operations, analytics, or human capital in fast-paced or high-growth environments. Experience with faculty or workforce planning, staffing strategy, succession planning, or organizational growth strategy strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success managing large-scale, cross-functional programs from planning through execution, using data insights, operational analyses, and reporting to inform strategic decision-making.
* Multidisciplinary and entrepreneurial, with the ability to connect strategy, design, and execution, navigate ambiguity, and own measurable outcomes across a broad scope of work.
* Track record of working effectively in a matrixed organization, building alignment and influencing cross-functional partners without relying on formal authority.
* Design-thinking orientation and demonstrated experience using AI and automation to redesign workflows, drive adoption, and improve efficiency or accuracy. Familiarity with AI-enabled workflows, agents, or enterprise planning platforms strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with experience building forecasts and models, conducting root-cause analyses, and presenting dashboards and organizational diagnostics to senior leaders.
* Ability to partner with technical and functional teams to extract and interpret data from HR and planning systems such as Workday, ensuring alignment between business needs and system capabilities.
* Exceptional organizational and program-management
